name: Energy & Power TRIZ
description: Same TRIZ machinery with energy / power vocabulary — generation, conversion, storage, transmission, efficiency and heat losses.

parameter_map.Loss of energy: efficiency losses — heat, line losses, conversion losses
parameter_map.Power: rated / peak power output vs demand
parameter_map.Use of energy by stationary object: standby consumption of fixed plant (pumps, fans, lighting)
parameter_map.Temperature: operating temperature of cells, windings, power devices
parameter_map.Reliability: grid availability / uptime / mean time between failures
parameter_map.Quantity of substance: fuel / electrolyte / storage capacity / coolant volume

principle_soft.1: segment the grid — microgrids and islandable sections that keep running alone
principle_soft.2: take the outage off the critical path — UPS, backup generation, uninterruptible supply
principle_soft.5: combine generation and storage — hybrid solar + wind + battery to smooth the curve
principle_soft.10: pre-charge reserves and pre-heat before the peak hits
principle_soft.15: dynamic load following; adaptive inverter setpoints as demand shifts
principle_soft.19: periodic charge/discharge rhythms matched to the demand cycle
principle_soft.24: intermediary buffer — battery bank or flywheel between generation and load
principle_soft.35: change the working state — phase-change storage, voltage-level conversion

examples: The inverter must handle more peak power, but adding cooling makes it too big for the cabinet.
Grid frequency must stay stable, but renewables inject power unpredictably.
The battery must charge faster, but fast charging degrades cell life and raises temperature.
